title: Leo Sprinkle finds Benowitz armed and saying 'they're coming'
place_text: Benowitz home, Four Hills, Albuquerque, New Mexico

tellings.quote: he said Bennis was there with like a like a rifle and a pistol and he said, you know, they're coming. You have to come in the house right now.

plain: Sometime in the late 1970s, a UFO researcher named Leo Sprinkle visited the Albuquerque home of a man named Paul Bennewitz, in the Four Hills neighbourhood. He is said to have found Bennewitz holding a rifle and a pistol and saying, "they're coming. You have to come in the house right now." The writer Greg Bishop tells Michels this as something Sprinkle told him, and he tells it to show how deeply Bennewitz's fear of aliens had gripped him.
